message.content: {"note_claim": "The video is not from Greenland but shows F-22 Raptors at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Alaska in March 2022.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "36 U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors assigned to the 3rd Wing launch and land at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson during Polar Force 22-4 in Anchorage, Alaska, March 31, 2022.", "reason": "The DVIDS page describes F-22s launching at JBER in Alaska on March 31, 2022, substantiating the note's claim about the video's location and date (though it doesn't address the flipping or Greenland troop numbers)."}

parsed.note_claim: The video is not from Greenland but shows F-22 Raptors at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson in Alaska in March 2022.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 36 U.S. Air Force F-22 Raptors assigned to the 3rd Wing launch and land at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson during Polar Force 22-4 in Anchorage, Alaska, March 31, 2022.
parsed.reason: The DVIDS page describes F-22s launching at JBER in Alaska on March 31, 2022, substantiating the note's claim about the video's location and date (though it doesn't address the flipping or Greenland troop numbers).
